name: Bard's Room
desc1: A cheerful-looking man with a colourful patched cloak is sitting in
desc2: this room, playing an elaborate platinum flute. He does not stir as
desc3: you enter, but instead continues with his song. When he finished, he
desc4: places his flute reverently in its case, and welcomes you with a
desc5: classical bow. The room continues to the south, where you can see a
desc6: large table covered in sheafs of paper.
